title.zh: 存款保险与保单持有人保障计划（罚款）命令 2024
title.en: Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Financial Penalty) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Financial Penalty) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 January 2025.

3. For the purposes of section 8(4) of the Act, the prescribed formula for the financial penalty (F) that a DI Scheme member is liable to pay for every day or part of a day that the DI Scheme member fails to comply with the asset maintenance requirement, is —
where —
(a)A is the deficiency in the amount of assets necessary for the DI Scheme member to comply with the asset maintenance requirement; and
(b)r is 10 percentage points above the 3‑month compounded SORA for —
(i)the day on which the bank fails to comply with the asset maintenance requirement — if that day is a business day; or
(ii)the last business day immediately before the day on which the bank fails to comply with the asset maintenance requirement — if that day is not a business day.
4. Revoke the Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Financial Penalty) Order 2011 (G.N. No. S 236/2011).
